records.skill_description: A high-speed rush of punches that charges briefly before dashing to the opponent and unleashing the punch sequence.
records.mechanics_notes: Short-range rushdown Strike Super: the user briefly pulls the arm back, then releases a rapid punch sequence ending in knock-away. The Xenoverse 2-specific source lists 7-hit/knock-away characteristics and 100 Ki. Mach Punch can combine with Mach Kick to perform Space Mach Attack. Exact frame/tracking/damage values remain unpromoted.
records.acquisition_notes: Mach Punch is a PQ19 reward for the Future Warrior. PQ19 documentation lists it under Basic Rewards. It is also available to Captain Ginyu and Jiren through Partner Customization after their respective updates. No Ultimate Finish requirement is promoted.
records.pve_notes: PQ19 farming is required for the documented Future Warrior route; exact drop probability and Ultimate Finish dependency remain unresolved.
records.pvp_notes: The move has a brief startup followed by a rapid multi-hit punch rush and can participate in the Space Mach Attack chain. Detailed frame and matchup claims remain version-sensitive.
